# Duck Donald Trump

> Political humor merch. One T-shirt: a cartoon rubber duck with an orange combover, captioned "*uck Donald Trump." Sold in White, Yellow, and Orange, printed and shipped on demand by Printful. $5 from every shirt goes to Democracy Forward Foundation, a 501(c)(3) legal nonprofit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://duckdonaldtrump.com/): the shirt, why it exists, FAQ, and the $DUCKTRUMP Solana token
- [Shop the shirt](https://duckdonaldtrump.printful.me/product/uck-donald-trump-t-shirt): checkout, sizes, and colors on Printful

## Donations

- [Democracy Forward Foundation](https://democracyforward.org/donate/): receives $5 from every shirt sold
